_comment: Thunder Bay dealers, all scraped browser-free. `convertus` (Wayne Toyota, Superior Hyundai): same-origin Convertus VMS JSON proxy — `cp` is the Convertus company id (watch the ajax-vehicles.php request the used page makes). `stm` (Gore Motors): WordPress Motors theme — reads the per-vehicle pages listed in `domain`/listings-sitemap.xml. `html` (default): generic three-strategy HTML scraper, best-effort (only yields with SCRAPE_JS_FALLBACK=1).
